description: React component for a view menu in a board application, allowing users to switch, duplicate, delete, and add different views (board, table, gallery, calendar) with permission gating.

methods.name: showView
methods.description: Generates a new URL path for a given view ID and navigates to it, appending read token if readonly.

methods.name: handleDuplicateView
methods.description: Duplicates the current active view, creates a new view block, and navigates to it.

methods.name: handleDeleteView
methods.description: Deletes the current active view and navigates to the next available view.

methods.name: handleViewClick
methods.description: Handles clicking on a view in the list, navigating to that view.

methods.name: handleAddViewBoard
methods.description: Creates and adds a new 'board' type view, then navigates to it.

methods.name: handleAddViewTable
methods.description: Creates and adds a new 'table' type view, then navigates to it.

methods.name: handleAddViewGallery
methods.description: Creates and adds a new 'gallery' type view, then navigates to it.

methods.name: handleAddViewCalendar
methods.description: Creates and adds a new 'calendar' type view, then navigates to it.

methods.name: iconForViewType
methods.description: Returns the appropriate icon component based on the view type.
